candidate: Monthly observed Dipodomys merriami capture reappearance across 24 Portal Project plots

publication.citation: Ernest et al. (2018), The Portal Project: a long-term study of a Chihuahuan desert ecosystem

pre_response_forbidden: Rodents/Portal_rodent.csv beyond its first physical header record
any mirror or derived table containing row-level Portal rodent captures
any fitted or reconstructed D. merriami response values

node_geometry.coordinate_axis: author-released projected east/north coordinates in meters
node_geometry.point_construction: for each integer plot 1..24, take the arithmetic mean east and north across exactly the 49 released rows with type=stake; do not relabel, drop or impute the pinned file's plot-1 stake-number anomaly
node_geometry.flag_policy: retain all released stake coordinates; flag marks lower GPS accuracy and does not mark an absent coordinate

response_semantics.event: an effort-eligible plot with zero focal captures in source period has one or more focal capture rows in target period
response_semantics.non_event: an effort-eligible plot with zero focal captures in source period has zero focal capture rows in target period
response_semantics.source_state: all effort-eligible plots with one or more focal capture rows in the source period
response_semantics.zero_boundary: zero is inferred only from the separate effort ledger when sampled=1, effort>=47 and qcflag=1
response_semantics.normal_protocol: period must be positive; negative special-trapping periods are excluded as directed by the official README
response_semantics.temporal_adjacency: source and target periods must map to consecutive newmoonnumber values
response_semantics.claim_limit: observed internal source-conditioned capture support, not latent occupancy, individual movement, ancestry, or biological closure

temporal_split.fit_policy: fit once on pooled calibration risk rows only; never refit on heldout outcomes

world_scale.interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice local, intermediate and spanning structural regimes; not biological dispersal limits

response_header_firewall.candidate_basis: official current writer fixes 31 columns and official EML/Methods disagree only on prevlet versus prevlt; this finite pair is frozen before physical header access

stage_boundary.next_if_green: freeze the one observed physical header, full 16-key paired contract, exact-count-first runner and synthetic smoke before adding a marker-only once authorization commit
stage_boundary.failure_action: record the pre-response stop and do not redesign this candidate after opening any response row
